scope: Coinbase's multi-stablecoin distribution, custody, collateral and settlement position across USDC, RLUSD and OUSD

observations.value: Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase app
notes: Supported-region customers can trade/manage RLUSD and convert USD to RLUSD 1:1.
Deposits and withdrawals at launch across XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase Global Exchange availability, including RLUSD collateral use, was explicitly described as a future follow-up; do not treat RLUSD as already eligible collateral on Global Exchange at launch.
Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base to support RLUSD use.

observations.metric: Average USDC held in Coinbase products
notes: Q3 2026 average was $22B, about 30% of average USDC market cap.
The deck identifies $2B as corporate balances; therefore the $22B is not all customer-held USDC.
Coinbase stated it captured approximately 50% of USDC economics over the prior year; this is a company-defined metric, not an independently decomposed profit share.
Coinbase reported 10.7% crypto trading-volume market share and assets on platform equal to 12.5% of total crypto market capitalization.

observations.metric: Circle distribution costs in connection with Coinbase agreements
notes: Circle describes an allocation formula based on USDC held on Coinbase's platform after issuer retention, plus half of remaining broader ecosystem-growth payment base after approved third-party participant payments.
These are reported distribution costs, not a separately disclosed net cash payment amount or Coinbase net profit.
Circle also distributes USDC through other partners; Coinbase is a major partner, not an exclusive distributor.
Coinbase is one of five founding partners of Open Standard with Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa.
Coinbase's OUSD support began Oct 1 according to launch reporting; the stablecoin is issued by Bridge, a Stripe company.
OUSD uses a partner-reward model tied to supply/activity and reserve income, creating a competing distribution/economic model to USDC.
XRP is accepted cross collateral for selected Global Exchange perpetual-futures margin products.
UBO-level ADQ caps and the greater of base/closeout-horizon haircuts apply.
Actual XRP collateral quantity, ADQ caps and aggregate utilization remain undisclosed.
XRP-PERP is USDC-settled; the asset used as collateral can be different from the settlement asset.
cbXRP is backed 1:1 by XRP held by Coinbase; cbXRP exists on Base.
Reserve/supply is custody backing, not evidence that the XRP is pledged to derivatives or loans.
Coinbase interface offers USDC borrowing via Morpho on Base against XRP collateral.
US availability excludes New York; actual outstanding XRP-backed loans and collateral utilization are not disclosed.

relationship_graph.scope_note: Prime, Exchange and retail app; supported regions; deposits/withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Direct liquidity-support statement; amount and market-making terms undisclosed.
Q2 2026 distribution costs $324.6M; H1 $655.3M; formula-based allocation.
Coinbase is simultaneously a major USDC distribution partner and a founding partner in a competing stablecoin network.
Actual utilization and product-specific caps remain unknown.
1:1 wrapped asset; reserve snapshot does not show collateral pledges.
USDC settlement does not prove Circle is the contract counterparty.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is positioning itself as a multi-stablecoin distribution, custody and collateral hub rather than an exclusive USDC venue.
supporting: USDC distribution economics with Circle; OUSD founding partnership; RLUSD listing across Prime/Exchange/Retail; XRP collateral and cbXRP custody.
disconfirming: USDC remains a record $22B average balance and major part of Coinbase's economics; RLUSD collateral availability on Global Exchange was still future at launch.
hypotheses.test: Track product volumes, custody balances, mint/redeem flows, fee economics, collateral eligibility and customer balance migration by stablecoin.

hypotheses.claim: RLUSD distribution on Coinbase could expand XRP Ledger stablecoin activity without creating proportional XRP spot demand.
supporting: Coinbase supports RLUSD deposits/withdrawals on XRPL and Ripple provides Base liquidity.
disconfirming: XRP remains necessary for XRPL fees/reserves, but these are bounded and do not scale one-for-one with RLUSD volume.
hypotheses.test: Measure RLUSD transfer volume on XRPL by payment type, XRP fees/reserves, bridge use and market-maker inventory.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's simultaneous Circle USDC and Open Standard OUSD roles create a strategic hedge and could alter Circle's distribution economics.
supporting: Circle pays material distribution costs under its Coinbase agreement; Coinbase is also a founding partner in OUSD's competing partner-revenue model.
disconfirming: No evidence yet that Coinbase has reduced USDC support or shifted meaningful balances to OUSD.
hypotheses.test: Compare Circle distribution expenses, Coinbase USDC revenue, OUSD balances/flows and Coinbase product placement over time.

hypotheses.claim: XRP collateral, cbXRP and Morpho loans can increase XRP capital utility but also create liquidation feedback.
supporting: Coinbase accepts XRP as collateral in selected derivatives and lending products; cbXRP has a large 1:1 backing reserve.
disconfirming: No public aggregate XRP pledge, loan utilization or product-level liquidation data.
hypotheses.test: Track cbXRP mint/burn, Morpho collateral balances, exchange ADQ/haircut schedules and liquidation events.

data_quality: RLUSD Global Exchange collateral availability was announced as future on 2026-10-28; do not describe it as active at launch.
RLUSD availability is limited to supported regions; exact jurisdiction matrix is not in the announcement.
Circle distribution costs are accounting expenses and not a disclosed cash transfer or Coinbase net profit.
Coinbase's $22B average USDC includes $2B corporate balances; do not call the full $22B customer deposits.
The '50% of USDC economics' figure is Coinbase-reported and company-defined.
OUSD founding partner liquidity commitment >$1B is a forward commitment, not current funded supply.
Coinbase cbXRP proof-of-reserves is first-party; no independent attestation was identified on the page.
XRP collateral eligibility, cbXRP reserve backing and actual collateral utilization are distinct metrics.
next_actions: Track Coinbase's follow-up announcement for RLUSD collateral availability on Global Exchange.
Measure RLUSD transfer volume on XRPL versus Base and Ethereum after Coinbase listing.
Compare Coinbase USDC distribution economics with OUSD partner revenue and RLUSD adoption.
Track cbXRP supply/reserves, Morpho XRP collateral and Global Exchange XRP collateral utilization if public.
Review Circle Q3 2026 results on Nov 4, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET for updated USDC circulation and distribution costs.
